title: Country Reputation and Corporate Activity
year_note: frame.csv lists 2023 (online date 2023-05-11); published volume 70 issue 3 (2024).
eligible_reason: Table 3 column 1 (Tables/Table 3.do line 54) is a static TWFE: reghdfe LOG_SEGMENT_SALES TREATMENT, absorb(SURVEY_YEAR FIRM_SEGMENT_GP), cluster(CLUSTER_GP), with no controls. TREATMENT = post x treatedpair (prep file line 416), where post = 1 in survey years strictly after the first successful terror attack in the firm's home country whose victims included nationals of the foreign segment country (first_event_year, defined at the home-country x foreign-country pair level; cohorts 2001-2013 after dropping 2000, 2014 and 2015 events) and never switches off; firm-segments in country pairs with no such attack are never treated. Figure 1's 'firms without name exposure' series (Figures/Figure 1.do line 47) is an unstacked event study with the same fixed effects and no controls. Both satisfy PROTOCOL.md Section 2. All other columns (Table 3 cols 2-7, Tables 4-7, Figures 2-3) include time-varying firm or country controls or treatment interactions.
design_notes: Firm-segment-year panel from Worldscope geographic segments (ITEM6105 firm x survey_country foreign segment; FIRM_SEGMENT_GP), survey_year >= 1995 to 2015. Outcome LOG_SEGMENT_SALES = log(1 + USD segment sales / 10,000), winsorized at 2.5%. Treatment from the Global Terrorism Database (0. Prepare GTD data.do): successful attacks since 2000, excluding target type 4, with at least one victim of the foreign nationality; first_event_year = earliest such attack per (home country, victim country) pair; post = first_event_year < survey_year; TREATMENT = post x treatedpair. Sample restrictions (prep file lines 437-478): non-missing BVA, cash flow, leverage, Tobin's Q; positive total segment sales; at least 2 firms per country pair; firm present in at least 2 country pairs and more than one foreign segment; drop Fama-French-48 financials; total USD segment sales >= 100,000. Cluster CLUSTER_GP = foreign (survey) country, 92 clusters. Table 3 col 1 real-data log: N = 243,543; 21 year FE; 21,468 firm-segment FE; TREATMENT = -0.4116 (0.1590), t = -2.59. Cols 2-7 add controls and industry-year, foreign-country-year, home-country-year and firm-year FE. Table 4: interactions with name-resemblance indicators. Table 5: country-pair-year reputation outcomes (BAV) with country controls. Table 6: media coverage / promotion / reputation interactions. Table 7: firm-level Q, M/B, sales growth, ROE with controls. Figure 1 (Figure 1.do lines 35-48): event-time dummies m5..m1, p0..p5 relative to first_event_year on a window event_time in [-6, 5] plus never-treated (0. Prepare Figures.do lines 27-45; p6-p10 drop out), outcome LOG_SEGMENT_SALES1 = LOG_SEGMENT_SALES / 7.886; series 'together' and name-exposure subsamples include controls, series 'nottop1' (large2 == 0) has none: N = 164,279, 91 clusters, all coefficients within +/- 0.025 and insignificant.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: first_event_year takes values 2001-2013 after the code drops 2000, 2014 and 2015 events (log line 70272: 2001 7,919; 2002 3,861; 2003 2,888; 2004 1,907; 2005 16,262; 2006 3,101; 2007 6,930; 2008 12,157; 2009 1,968; 2010 370; 2011 1,051; 2012 67; 2013 130 pair-year rows before sample restrictions). Post starts the year after the event.
preferred_spec_note: Table 3 column 1 is the no-controls baseline of the main table; the authors' headline columns likely include controls (cols 2-7). Mark preferred = unclear until the article text is available.

published_estimates.source: LOG/MS-FIN-19-02808.smcl (authors' real-data log; Excel Outputs/Table3.xls rounds to 2 decimals)

published_estimates.note: [coef, se]; outcome rescaled by 1/7.886; p6-p10 omitted (collinear) because the window is event_time in [-6, 5].

specs.outcome: LOG_SEGMENT_SALES = log(1 + survey_country_sales x lagged HQ exchange rate / 10,000), winsorized 2.5%
specs.treatment_definition: 1 for firm-segment-years with survey_year > first_event_year of the (home country, foreign country) pair, where first_event_year is the first successful terror attack in the home country since 2000 with victims from the foreign country (GTD); absorbing; cohorts 2001-2013; pairs with no attack never treated
specs.unit_var: FIRM_SEGMENT_GP (firm x foreign country); assignment unit = country pair (BRAND_GP x SURVEY_COUNTRY_GP)
specs.sample_condition: Table3.dta as built by '0. Prepare segment data and clean up data for Table 3.do' (lines 360-522): survey_year >= 1995; non-missing BVA, CF2AT2, LEVERAGE2, LOG_Q2; positive segment sales; >= 2 firms per pair; firm in >= 2 pairs and > 1 foreign segment; drop FF48 industry 48; total USD segment sales >= 1e5; first_event_year not in {2000, 2014, 2015}
specs.data_file: Table3.dta (NOT shipped; built from Worldscope wrds_ws_segments_5*.dta, wrds_ws_company_2, wrds_ws_stock_2, wrds_ws_funda_2, currencymapping.dta and shipped GTD1.dta)
specs.notes: Firm-segment FE are nested within the foreign-country cluster. Within R2 0.0004.

specs.treatment_var: m5 m4 m3 m2 m1 p0 p1 p2 p3 p4 p5 (p6-p10 included but collinear/omitted)
specs.treatment_definition: event_time = survey_year - first_event_year for treated pairs (missing for never-treated); m_k = 1[event_time == -k], p_k = 1[event_time == k]; sample keeps event_time in [-6, 5] plus never-treated, so t = -6 and never-treated form the reference
specs.sample_condition: Figure1_data.dta: prefigure.dta with keep if abs(event_time)<=6 | first_event_year==.; keep if event_time>=-6; drop if p6; and large2 == 0 (firms without top-name resemblance to their home country)
specs.event_bins: t = -5..-1, 0..+5; omitted t = -6 (and never-treated); window excludes t <= -7 and t >= +6
specs.notes: The other three Figure 1 series (all firms; name-exposure firms, raw and adjusted outcome) include the six time-varying controls and are not eligible. Unusual reference period (t = -6).

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls in every column (cols 3-7 also add industry-year, foreign-country-year, home-country-year, firm-year FE)
specs.fe: col 2: SURVEY_YEAR + FIRM_SEGMENT_GP; col 3: ind_yr_gp + FIRM_SEGMENT_GP; col 4: + SURVEY_YEAR##SURVEY_COUNTRY_GP; col 5: + SURVEY_YEAR##BRAND_GP; col 6: both; col 7: FIRM_SEGMENT_GP + SURVEY_YEAR##SURVEY_COUNTRY_GP + FIRM_GP##SURVEY_YEAR (lines 59-84)
specs.controls: LOG_SEGMENT_AGE LOG_NR_OTHER_SEGMENTS SEGMENT_HHI CASH_FLOW_TO_ASSETS LEVERAGE LOG_TOBINS_Q (time-varying firm/segment covariates)
specs.notes: Col 2 real-data log: TREATMENT -0.4121 (0.1683), N 243,543. Controls-free versions of cols 3-6 would be eligible (time-invariant group x year FE) but are not reported.

specs.exclusion_reason: treatment x name-resemblance interactions; time-varying controls
specs.controls: LOG_SEGMENT_AGE LOG_NR_OTHER_SEGMENTS SEGMENT_HHI CASH_FLOW_TO_ASSETS LEVERAGE LOG_TOBINS_Q (time-varying firm/segment covariates)

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying country controls (GDP, population, GATT/WTO, common currency); country-pair panel
specs.treatment_definition: post x treated at the country-pair level
specs.notes: Figure 2 is the event-study version with controls.

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying firm controls (LOG_AGE LOG_BVA LOG_BVA_SQ, CF_TO_AT LEVERAGE)
specs.treatment_definition: firm exposed to a reputation shock in any segment
specs.controls: LOG_AGE LOG_BVA LOG_BVA_SQ (+ CF_TO_AT LEVERAGE for ROE)
specs.notes: Figure 3 is the event-study version with controls.

data_access_note: Worldscope segment, company, stock and fundamentals files (WRDS), BAV country reputation surveys, Factiva, Osiris are licensed and not shipped; the package ships only the GTD-derived treatment file GTD1.dta and the promotion-agency file IPA1.dta, plus the full Stata log and Excel outputs. The exchange-rate file currencymapping.dta used in the Table 3 build is not shipped.
data_files: Code and Data/Data/GTD1.dta (country-pair first attack years; shipped)
software_notes: Stata (reghdfe, outreg2, winsor, ffind, coefplot); Python notebook for tF values.
replication_feasible_note: Table 3 column 1 needs only Worldscope segment data (available through WRDS subscriptions), the shipped GTD1.dta and the unshipped currencymapping.dta (HQ-currency to USD rates); the build code is complete. Figure 1 additionally needs prefigure.dta / large2 (name-resemblance flag from Table 4's build). Author contact recommended for Table3.dta and currencymapping.dta.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Treatment variable traced from GTD prep (first_event_year = min attack year by pair) through '0. Prepare segment data and clean up data for Table 3.do' (post, treatedpair, inter -> TREATMENT). Cohort counts and real-data estimates taken from the authors' log. Flags cite Goodman-Bacon and Callaway-Sant'Anna but no modern estimator appears in the code.
